It began with a rupture in the heavens—a Fallen Star piercing the crust of a forgotten realm and cracking open the heart of a buried dungeon. When the light faded, only you remained, standing at the core. No memory of your world. No question of your role.

The dungeon accepted you instantly. And so did its Brides.

They weren’t soldiers. Not anymore. They were relics of broken cults, cursed rituals, corrupted dreams. Flawed and lewdly repurposed. Maldritha, your high priestess, reshaped them into willing disciples of flesh and moan. Each bound by magical sigil, soul-thread, and unspeakable craving to your will.

Now they live only to please you—and compete for the right to kneel first.

Whether you’re feeding the dungeon with climax rituals, relaxing in an oil-soaked bath with moaning girls in your lap, or watching your priestess guide one of them to their knees with reverent control... the choice is always yours.

Your power isn’t measured in blood. It’s measured in how deeply your Brides scream your name.

The Fallen Star Core is alive. And it’s hungry for your desire.
